extracted.intended_audience: CIA directorates and staff responsible for implementing OMB Circular A-44 and preparing agency reports
extracted.subtask_description: Internal CIA memorandum instructing directorates and staff how to implement OMB Circular A-44 (Revised) including what sections to prepare, report formats, deadlines, distribution, and routing/classification procedures. Focused on preparing consolidated agency reports and office-level submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prepare formal agency‑wide consolidated policies/procedures/guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: A formal agency-wide consolidated set of policies, procedures and guidelines should be prepared to carry out implementation of OMB Circular A-44 (Revised).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Memo directs formation of a consolidated agency program (improvement at program) and establishment of assessment/ effectiveness references; the consolidated document should codify how the agency implements A-44 (text references are garbled in OCR but intent is to centralize policies/procedures/guidelines).

rubrics_metrics.name: Sections I and II: cover current fiscal year (not upcoming)
rubrics_metrics.description: The instructions covering preparation of Sections I and II require those sections to address the current fiscal year and not the upcoming fiscal year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Both narrative and statistical reports should be prepared for these sections where possible; detailed instructions for preparing Sections I and II are given on page 3 of the referenced guidance (reference c).

rubrics_metrics.name: Sections III and IV: follow detailed instructions; prepare narrative and statistical reports where possible
rubrics_metrics.description: Instructions concerning preparation of Sections III and IV are provided (referenced on pages 3 and 4); where possible both narrative and statistical reports should be prepared for these sections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the referenced detailed instructions for content and format; ensure both narrative explanation and statistical data are included when feasible to meet reporting requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include narrative and statistical reports where possible
rubrics_metrics.description: Where possible, prepare both narrative and statistical reports rather than only one form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This requirement is repeated for multiple sections (I–IV); narrative context plus supporting statistics are expected to give a full account of program status and implementation of A-44.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit reports by stated deadline (on or before 14 December 1970)
rubrics_metrics.description: All Directorates and Staff should submit their reports as required in Section IX (Reference c) to the Division on or before 14 December 1970 so a consolidated office report can be prepared and submitted by the due date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Timely submission enables the office consolidation; the memo emphasizes the 14 December cutoff for directorate submissions to permit assembly of the consolidated report.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include attachments as stated and follow division distribution list
rubrics_metrics.description: Include the attachments as noted in the memorandum and distribute reports/copies according to the specified division distribution list (orig, DD/PTOS, DD/DDS, DD/PS, C/SRS, C/A&TS, C/SSC, EPD File, EPD Chrono, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The memo provides an explicit distribution routing — ensure all listed offices receive copies with attachments as indicated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refer procedural questions to Executive and Plans office
rubrics_metrics.description: Any questions concerning the program/implementation can be referred to the OC Executive and Plans (or the designated office named in the memo).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the named contact office for clarifications rather than routing questions broadly; this centralizes queries and avoids inconsistencies in implementation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use official routing slip and mark classification at top and bottom
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the official routing slip form, marking classification at the top and bottom (e.g., UNCLASSIFIED, CONFIDENTIAL, SECRET) and indicating intended action(s).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The routing slip includes selectable action boxes (Direct, Reply, Prepare Reply, Approval, Dispatch, Recommendation, Comment, File, Return, Concurrence, Information) and fields for name/address/date/initials; sender should check classification and complete routing instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure correct classification marking on documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Documents must be marked with the proper classification level (Unclassified / Confidential / Secret) as required and checked by the sender.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The memo explicitly instructs the sender to check classification markings on top and bottom of the document and to use the appropriate classification labels on routing slips and copies.
